infoBoard.title: Welcome to Nautilus Client!
infoBoard.message: The Closed Alpha test has started for remote users! Feel free to report any issues or bugs during this first round of testing.

infoBoard.title: Nautilus 3i (thinking) is currently unavailable
infoBoard.message: Due to some behavioral issues from the last update, the reasoning/thinking version of 3i is not available until some problems are fixed. Nautilus 3i Quick is unaffected!
